Hi Aaron — following up with technical specifics for the manifest and signature expectations.

Manifest requirements (CSV):
- columns: file_path, file_size_bytes, sha256_hex, control_tag, producing_team, upload_batch_id
- header row required, UTF-8 encoding.

PGP signature:
- Sign the entire archive (tar.gz or zip) with your corporate key. We will verify the signature against the attached pgp_public_key.asc.
- Include the detached signature file named <archive>.sig alongside the archive in the upload.

Upload mechanics:
- For files <250MB: single PUT to the provided pre-signed URL.
- For files >=250MB: use multipart pre-signed URLs; Vendr will return a set of part URLs and an overall manifest id.
- After upload completes, post a short confirmation JSON to https://vendr.example/uploads/req-48291/confirm with the upload_batch_id and checksum. (If you prefer, Ben can coordinate with procurement to trigger the confirmation.)

Sample manifest and a small test archive would let us validate the signature and CSV parsing. I've attached an example manifest (evidence_manifest.csv) to this thread for your team to model.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Security Intake — Redwood Inference
